newsitem.title: USA: Irwin Financial to buy back up to 1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Irwin Financial to buy back up to 1.1 mln.

text.p: Irwin Financial Corp said Tuesday its directors authorized the repurchase of up to 1.1 million shares of the company's 11.1 million common shares outstanding.

The shares will be repurchased, at times and amounts to be determined by management as market conditions and capital position warrant, in the open market at prevailing prices or through negotiated off-market transactions.

Repurchased shares will be placed in treasury and may subsequently be reissued for the company's dividend reinvestment plans, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k) savings plan, stock option plans, and other general corporate purposes, Irwin Financial said in a news release.

This repurchase program replaces one that the company has has been operating under since August 1994, in which it was authorized to repurchase up to 1.2 million shares. About one million shares, or 87.2 percent of the authorization, were repurchased under the previous program.
Shares of Irwin Financial, which provides specialized financial services, were trading up 7/8 to 31.
